name: $createBackup
description: Creates a backup of the specified database

name: $removeBackup
description: Removes a backup of the specified data type

name: $restoreBackup
description: Restores database from backup if the database is not active

name: $leaderBoard
description: Loads the entire sorted ranked list into the environment variable

name: $nearbyBoard
description: Shows the count of competitors before and after the entity in the leaderboard

name: $pageBoard
description: Loads a paginated leaderboard slice into the environment variable

name: $positionBoard
description: Returns the position of the specified entity in the ranked list

name: $activeDB
description: Returns a list of active databases

name: $closeDB
description: Closes the connection to one or more databases

name: $keysDB
description: Retrieves all keys from the database

name: $openDB
description: Opens a connection to one or more databases

name: $pingDB
description: Checks the database response time

name: $prefetchDB
description: Prefetches database entries into memory to speed up future access

name: $rangeDB
description: Retrieves all records from the database

name: $reloadDB
description: Reloads database configuration from file

name: $searchDB
description: Searches the database with various filters

args.name: type
args.description: Data type (if not specified, searches all open databases)

name: $wipeDB
description: Deletes one or more databases

name: $hold
description: Applies a hold timer to prevent repeated actions

name: $key
description: Builds a composite key

name: $existsRecord
description: Checks if a record exists for the key

name: $getRecord
description: Saves record data into an environment variable

name: $moveRecord
description: Moves data from one record to another

args.name: delete source
args.description: Whether to delete source record after moving (default: true)

name: $putRecord
description: Sets new data for the key

name: $removeRecord
description: Deletes the record of the specified key

name: $valueRecord
description: Gets a variable value from a record
